response.summary: The customer recently took over a frozen-goods terminal in Aarhus with a mixed fleet of old handheld scanners, half of which die within an hour in the freezer. They asked directly for equipment rated for −30 °C; the X60 was presented as a freezer-rated replacement (IP67, ~14 h battery in cold environments) and the customer moved straight to requesting a spec sheet and indicative pricing for about 20 units. Staffing levels in the freezer section remain unknown. Clear, fast-moving opportunity with a concrete next step.
